Module.Title: PF2E Affliction Forge: Wilderness Maladies
Module.LibraryDescription: Original environment-linked wilderness afflictions with broad habitat coverage and semantic Creature Forge tags.
Module.SyncFailed: Wilderness Maladies could not synchronize its library. See console.

reed-fever.Name: Reed Fever
reed-fever.Description: Damp reed spores lodge in the airways and mucous membranes. The fever is especially common around swamps and still water.

dune-ant-venom.Name: Dune Ant Venom
dune-ant-venom.Description: The burning sting of large desert ants makes muscles tremble and joints seize.

pine-needle-rot.Name: Pine Needle Rot
pine-needle-rot.Description: A fungus in rotting pine litter enters through tiny skin breaks and stiffens the limbs.

saltmarsh-bite.Name: Saltmarsh Bite
saltmarsh-bite.Description: Tiny marsh biters deliver a fast-acting neurotoxin in their saliva.

glacier-lung.Name: Glacier Lung
glacier-lung.Description: Ice-blue mold from glacier crevasses irritates the lungs and slowly drains warmth from the body.

sunthorn-sap.Name: Sunthorn Sap
sunthorn-sap.Description: The milky sap of this desert plant burns mucous membranes and causes violent nausea.

cave-bloom-spores.Name: Cave Bloom Spores
cave-bloom-spores.Description: The unassuming cave bloom releases spore clouds that settle deep in the lungs.

storm-gull-fever.Name: Storm Gull Fever
storm-gull-fever.Description: A pathogen common among coastal birds causes chills and vomiting after contact with feathers or droppings.

ember-tick-venom.Name: Ember Tick Venom
ember-tick-venom.Description: Ember ticks live along the edges of lava fields; their venom carries the heat of their habitat into the bloodstream.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 2d6 poison damage, 1d6 fire damage, Clumsy 1.

bog-rot.Name: Bog Rot
bog-rot.Description: Black bog mud harbors decay organisms that inflame wounds and darken living tissue.

cliff-viper-venom.Name: Cliff Viper Venom
cliff-viper-venom.Description: Cliff viper venom rapidly strips away muscular control.

redgrass-fever.Name: Redgrass Fever
redgrass-fever.Description: During flowering season, wind carries redgrass seed hairs across the plains; some trigger a stubborn fever.

jungle-leech-fever.Name: Jungle Leech Fever
jungle-leech-fever.Description: Leeches from warm jungle waters leave parasites that worsen blood loss and weakness.

salt-sting-toxin.Name: Salt-Sting Toxin
salt-sting-toxin.Description: The spines of certain reef and coastal fish inject a paralyzing toxin.

frost-moss-blight.Name: Frost Moss Blight
frost-moss-blight.Description: Frost moss works through clothing and armor into the skin, drawing heat from muscle and blood.

thunder-bloom-pollen.Name: Thunder Bloom Pollen
thunder-bloom-pollen.Description: Charged pollen from thunder blooms triggers painful electrical discharges inside the body.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 2d6 poison damage, 2d6 electricity damage, Clumsy 1.

volcanic-ash-sickness.Name: Volcanic Ash Sickness
volcanic-ash-sickness.Description: Ash saturated with primal energy clogs the airways and kindles the blood with inner heat.

mangrove-scorpion-venom.Name: Mangrove Scorpion Venom
mangrove-scorpion-venom.Description: The dark venom of mangrove scorpions numbs limbs within a few heartbeats.

whiteout-curse.Name: Whiteout Curse
whiteout-curse.Description: Some ancient snowstorms carry the wrath of primal spirits. Those who wander too long within them lose direction, warmth, and eventually their own will.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 4d6 cold damage, Stupefied 1, Slowed 1. Certain conditions cannot fall below their minimum value during this stage.

sinkhole-miasma.Name: Sinkhole Miasma
sinkhole-miasma.Description: A foul mist rises from deep sinkholes, choking the lungs and wasting the body.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 4d6 void damage, Sickened 2, Drained 2. You cannot speak. Damage caused by this affliction cannot be healed.

ironroot-sap.Name: Ironroot Sap
ironroot-sap.Description: The metallic-smelling sap of ancient ironroots hardens muscles and tendons almost like wood.

stormscar-fever.Name: Stormscar Fever
stormscar-fever.Description: Those marked by certain storm creatures carry electrical discharges through their own nervous system.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 4d6 electricity damage, Fatigued, Clumsy 1. Concentrate actions require a DC 5 flat check.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 5d6 electricity damage, Drained 1, Clumsy 2. Concentrate actions require a DC 6 flat check.

razor-reef-toxin.Name: Razor Reef Toxin
razor-reef-toxin.Description: Reef spines and camouflaged coastal hunters combine venom with deep wounds that refuse to clot.

Stage1.Name: Stage 1
Stage1.Description: Effects: 4d6 poison damage, 1d6 persistent bleed damage.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 4d6 poison damage, 2d6 persistent bleed damage, Clumsy 1.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 5d6 poison damage, 2d6 persistent bleed damage, Clumsy 2.

black-canopy-fever.Name: Black Canopy Fever
black-canopy-fever.Description: Beneath dense jungle canopy thrives a black spore fungus that spreads rapidly through the blood.

mirage-curse.Name: Mirage Curse
mirage-curse.Description: Primal desert magic causes reality and mirage to bleed together until even familiar thoughts become unreliable.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 4d6 mental damage, Stupefied 1. Concentrate actions require a DC 5 flat check.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 5d6 mental damage, Stupefied 2, Confused. Concentrate actions require a DC 7 flat check. Certain conditions cannot fall below their minimum value during this stage.

deepfrost-worm.Name: Deepfrost Worm
deepfrost-worm.Description: These pale parasites survive in ice caverns and frozen carcasses, feeding on body heat.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 6d6 cold damage, Drained 2, Sickened 2. Damage caused by this affliction cannot be healed.

magma-blood-venom.Name: Magma-Blood Venom
magma-blood-venom.Description: The venom of volcanic reptiles and draconic beasts seems to poison and ignite the blood at once.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 5d6 poison damage, 3d6 fire damage, Clumsy 1.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 6d6 poison damage, 4d6 fire damage, Clumsy 2, Slowed 1.

elder-grove-curse.Name: Elder Grove Curse
elder-grove-curse.Description: A sacred grove can mark trespassers with a slow primal doom that binds mind and body to its roots.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 5d6 mental damage, Stupefied 1, Clumsy 1. Damage caused by this affliction cannot be healed.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 6d6 mental damage, Stupefied 2, Slowed 1. You cannot regain Hit Points. Certain conditions cannot fall below their minimum value during this stage.

bottomless-bog-plague.Name: Bottomless Bog Plague
bottomless-bog-plague.Description: In ancient bogs, decay, spores, and primal corruption form a disease that resists even magical healing.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 7d6 void damage, Sickened 2, Drained 2, Slowed 1. Damage caused by this affliction cannot be healed.

skyfire-blight.Name: Skyfire Blight
skyfire-blight.Description: Lightning from primal storms can leave a living scar that repeatedly drives heat and electricity through the body.

Stage1.Name: Stage 1
Stage1.Description: Effects: 5d6 electricity damage, 2d6 fire damage, Fatigued.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 6d6 electricity damage, 3d6 fire damage, Drained 1. Concentrate actions require a DC 6 flat check.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 7d6 electricity damage, 4d6 fire damage, Drained 2, Slowed 1. Concentrate actions require a DC 8 flat check. Damage caused by this affliction cannot be healed.

wasteland-crown.Name: Wasteland Crown
wasteland-crown.Description: Cursed wastelands crown their victims with invisible heat and drought until body and mind wither.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 6d6 fire damage, Drained 2, Stupefied 1. Damage caused by this affliction cannot be healed.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 7d6 fire damage, Drained 2, Stupefied 2, Slowed 1. You cannot regain Hit Points. Certain conditions cannot fall below their minimum value during this stage.

worldroot-blight.Name: Worldroot Blight
worldroot-blight.Description: An ancient wilderness doom attacks its victim’s connection to life. In its final stage, the wild itself attempts to erase the victim from the cycle of life.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 8d6 void damage, Drained 2, Stupefied 2, Slowed 1. You cannot regain Hit Points. Certain conditions cannot fall below their minimum value during this stage.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 10d6 void damage, Drained 3, Stupefied 2, death effect. You cannot regain Hit Points. Certain conditions cannot fall below their minimum value during this stage.
